draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 104th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 237, well after his grade rank (104th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Donte Jackson. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile). Testing concerns: broad jump (3rd percentile). College production: 9 passes defended in 2019, 7th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.
